objects.original: The source fixed-reference center c=y-eta*grad V(xRef), literal harmonic flow Phi, residual positive-part rate, weighted harmonic energy H, its original-state cap, integral first crossing and Exp(1) threshold.
objects.reconstructed: The decoder reconstructs exactly the eight local c,Phi,rate,H,C,Lambda,tau,W definitions; tau is hittingAfter into Ici(0), and W is the actual expMeasure(1) pushforward under tau composed with Real.toNNReal.
objects.evidence: Compared independently with primary S3.E4, A1.Ex1-4, A1.E1 and Ex6, then the complete 396-line current module. Vector signs, sqrt eta coefficients, residual gradient order, half-weighted sum energy and same H(z) in C agree. hittingAfter's inspected Mathlib definition is a nonempty-set sInf with explicit empty-set top, not a characterized replacement.

domains.original: Finite Euclidean R^d; flow time real; hazard/threshold times nonnegative; waiting time may be infinity; fixed arbitrary y,xRef,z.
domains.reconstructed: Finite-dimensional real inner-product space E with compatible norm/Borel structures; Phi at real times, Lambda and e on NNReal, tau on WithTop NNReal, and W a measure on that extended-time carrier.
domains.evidence: Finite real Hilbert E is an isometric Euclidean representation with its Borel structure. No positive-rank assumption is added. NNReal is exactly source u>=0. WithTop preserves empty crossings at infinity. The real Exp carrier adapter clamps only thresholds, and the exact all-real survival preimage proves the required marginal law without imposing support as a new caller.

quantifiers.original: All source-admissible V,alpha,beta,eta; every fixed y,xRef and phase point; every finite u>=0; the source recursion later inserts actual postjump states and independent Exp variables.
quantifiers.reconstructed: The theorem universally quantifies the same analytic inputs, all y,xRef,z and all e,t in NNReal; for each fixed y,xRef,z it proves an actual unit exponential pushforward probability and all finite-time strict tails.
quantifiers.evidence: The six callers are h_alpha,h_alpha_beta,h_V,h_H,h_eta,h_beta_eta, with no caller for a random state, energy layer, cap, integral, crossing or probability law. Local universal e=0 elaborates a null threshold edge case, without pretending iid recursion or process construction has been proved.

assumptions.evidence: beta is strictly positive from alpha>0 and alpha<=beta, so eta<=1/beta iff beta*eta<=1, including the endpoint. The nonnegative scalar carrier adds no assumption beyond the literal ordering. C2 makes the Hessian quadratic form the source Hessian. Flow/rate continuity, finite integrability, hazard monotonicity, exact cap and probability normalization are derived inside the proof. No higher derivatives, positive energy, positive dimension or almost-sure finite wait is introduced.
